definitions.explanation: A railway company that is privately owned, as opposed to government-operated railways like JR.

examples.japanese: {私鉄|してつ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{乗|の}る→乗る：00511_noru⟧。
⟦{通勤|つうきん}→通勤：03512_tsuukin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{私鉄|してつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}っている→使う：00473_tsukau⟧。
examples.english: I use a private railway for commuting.

examples.japanese: ⟦{東京|とうきょう}→東京：09564_toukyou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{多|おお}くの→多い：01127_ooi⟧{私鉄|してつ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{走|はし}っている→走る：00519_hashiru⟧。
examples.english: Many private railways run in Tokyo.

examples.japanese: {私鉄|してつ}⟦{各社|かくしゃ}→各社：11057_kakusha⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧ICカード⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{導入|どうにゅう}した→導入：10127_dounyuu⟧。
examples.english: Various private railway companies introduced IC cards.

examples.japanese: ⟦JR→JR：10126_jeiaaru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{私鉄|してつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{乗|の}り{継|つ}いで→乗り継ぐ：10128_noritsugu⟧⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{通|かよ}っている→通う：01217_kayou⟧。
examples.english: I commute to work by transferring between JR and a private railway.

notes:
{私鉄|してつ} refers to privately owned railways in Japan, as opposed to JR (Japan Railways) which was formerly government-owned.

Major private railways in Japan:
- ⟦{東急|とうきゅう}→東急：noentry⟧ (Tokyu)
- ⟦{小田急|おだきゅう}→小田急：noentry⟧ (Odakyu)
- ⟦{京王|けいおう}→京王：noentry⟧ (Keio)
- ⟦{西武|せいぶ}→西武：noentry⟧ (Seibu)
- ⟦{東武|とうぶ}→東武：noentry⟧ (Tobu)
- ⟦{阪急|はんきゅう}→阪急：noentry⟧ (Hankyu)
- ⟦{近鉄|きんてつ}→近鉄：noentry⟧ (Kintetsu)

Related terms:
- ⟦JR→JR：10126_jeiaaru⟧（ジェイアール） - Japan Railways
- ⟦{国鉄|こくてつ}→国鉄：noentry⟧ - Japanese National Railways (historical, now JR)
- ⟦{地下鉄|ちかてつ}→地下鉄：01020_chikatetsu⟧ - subway
- ⟦{鉄道|てつどう}→鉄道：03550_tetsudou⟧ - railway (the general term covering both)
